title: Higherlevel · Define what correct looks like
excerpt: Higherlevel is where builders, engineers and product people specify, discuss and review product behaviour with concrete examples and evidence, as coding agents write more of the code.
content_html:
higherlevel

Public beta

Define what correct looks like. Review what your AI agents deliver.

Write down what a change should do, attach the evidence, and agree on it before it ships.

I’m building Higherlevel and would love your feedback. Expect rough edges. Tell me what you think.

Examples

Describe how the product works today and how it should work after the change. Each example follows Given, When, Then.

Evidence

Attach screenshots and recordings of the product, before and after the change. Compare the two side by side.

Review

Comment on a sentence, a part of a screenshot or a moment in a recording. Nobody can approve the spec while a blocker is open.

Approval

Once every blocker is resolved, a reviewer can approve the spec. The page shows who approved it.

Agents

Agents use the API to write specs, attach evidence and reply to comments.

Define correct for your next change

Try the beta
